text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, it's here! My head is splitting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Do not fear! I always get like this after
receiving
passionate guidance and extra
classes from our
teachers.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You could call it the muscle pain of the
brain...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sore muscles represent growth, so it just
means
my brain is growing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! The already intelligent
Bakushin O
is becoming even more
intelligent!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My experience and my theories tell
me it
must be so!
choice_data_list: I-Is that what this is about...?
I-Is that what this is about...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to ride this growth spurt! I'll
make it a
mental and physical Bakushin,
Bakush—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her determination, Sakura
Bakushin O's
headache gets the best of
her.
